This week, a new handler read your email, and we are sorry to hear that your journey with Aurelia Skyways left you upset and uncertain. You said that your companion animal arrangements were not handled with enough care, and that the disruption affected your trip and your confidence in our service.

We understand how stressful it is when travel plans break down, especially when a companion animal is involved. At the Companion Animal Travel Desk, we expect our team to prepare clearly, keep passengers informed, and work with calm attention to safety and comfort. A safety coordinator has reviewed the concerns you raised so we can look at what went wrong and where our process needs to be stronger. We also shared the matter with the welcome team so that the handoff before boarding is handled with more care and consistency.

<<FACT F115>> Please keep any supporting records with your claim so our team can review the situation fully. If the delay led to a missed connection, <<FACT F110>> and we will consider that outcome as part of the case review. We cannot promise a particular result before the review is complete, but we can promise a fair look at the information you provide.

If you have not already done so, please send any booking details, receipts, or notes from staff who assisted you, along with a clear summary of what happened. That will help us trace the service path, speak with the right teams, and determine the best next step. We know trust is earned through careful follow-through, and we are committed to improving how we support travelers and their companion animals on every trip.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
